bio.text: Gabe Evans was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2024 and represents Colorado's 8th Congressional District.

He spent twelve years in the U.S. Army and the Colorado Army National Guard, including a combat deployment to the Middle East, serving as a UH-60 Black Hawk pilot and company commander and reaching the rank of Captain.
He joined the Arvada Police Department in 2011, retired as a Lieutenant, and was elected to Colorado House District 48 in 2022.
